reminders.text: A week on four cron slots: is the Telegram digest still arriving hours late? If yes, set up the outside clock (README, 'When the digest is late'; checklist item under Housekeeping).

Month-end: check the paper book's month in latest.json against the fund (the book's picks are logged by the job, no manual entry needed); compare last month's momentum-pullback paper trades in the journal with the backtest's expectancy.
Monthly: re-run the two backtests on the month's new bars (npm run backtest:momentum -- --benchmarks && npm run backtest) and compare with the previous month's reports; push.
Quarterly: from home, npm run corporate-actions (new bonuses/splits), then the two backtests; check every workflow's actions/* versions and Node version are still supported.

Three months of the paper book (since 13 Nov 2026): is the engine, both switches on, ahead of or behind NIFTY500 MOMENTUM 50 since then, on return and on drawdown (latest.json paper, data/benchmarks/live.json; refresh the TR files from niftyindices.com for the dividend-inclusive number)? Also the journal's momentum-pullback paper trades vs the backtest. Write the answer into ROADMAP.md.

Six months of the paper book. Decide: behind the fund on return and not clearly better on drawdown → the desk stays a monitor and the fund stays the holding; ahead → the owner's call on real money. Then, if everything above is ticked, schedule the final audit session (README, Housekeeping).
